hints.title: Marking Interval Endpoints
hints.text: Record the start and end coordinates of every painted segment in an ordered map of coordinate deltas.

hints.title: Maintaining Running Color Weight
hints.text: Add the segment color weight at the start point and subtract it at the end point.

hints.title: Building Continuous Color Bands
hints.text: Iterate sorted endpoint positions, creating segments with the accumulated color weight whenever positive.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import defaultdict

class Solution:
    def splitPainting(self, segments: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
        diff = defaultdict(int)
        endpoints = set()
        for start, end, color in segments:
            diff[start] += color
            diff[end] -= color
            endpoints.add(start)
            endpoints.add(end)
            
        sorted_pts = sorted(endpoints)
        ans = []
        curr_color = 0
        prev = sorted_pts[0]
        
        for pt in sorted_pts:
            if curr_color > 0 and pt > prev:
                ans.append([prev, pt, curr_color])
            curr_color += diff[pt]
            prev = pt
            
        return ans
```
